facts.text: CSU's RiverPark Campus in downtown Columbus features performance and teaching venues including the Schwob School of Music and housing for over 400 students.

sources.title: Campuses - Columbus State University
sources.quote: CSU's RiverPark Campus features some of the nation's most sophisticated teaching and performance spaces. Stretch your creative mind as you explore the Schwob School of Music, theaters, galleries, and art studios. With housing for more than 400 students
